page.overview:
Who is Eyebabes?

The Three Eyebabes are monsters created by Ice King for the Hall of Just Ice. They have the ability to shoot ice blasts from their eyes and they are the heralds of the giant Ice Queen that Ice King put in the dungeon alongside them. When Finn, Jake and Ice King came to explore the dungeon, they attempted to kill them but Jake was able to distract them while Finn snuck behind them and cut all three in half.
